# IME365 DIR-003 — SURFACE 2 MASTER ENGINEERING DIRECTIVE
## Surface 2 Modernization: Complete 12-Step Resume Engine, 51 Templates, A4 Page Composer, Cover Letter Studio, Web CV Builder & Live Interview Parity

**Directive ID:** DIR-003  
**Priority:** P0 — Critical  
**Surface:** Surface 2 of 5 (Candidate Dashboard & Complete Career Hub Suite)  
**Depends On:** DIR-002 (Unlocks automatically when DIR-002 is certified & frozen)  
**Executive Engineering Lead:** Antigravity (Google DeepMind)  
**Implementation Engine:** Claude Code CLI  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
Modernize the complete Candidate Dashboard and entire Career Builder Suite in React 19 / TypeScript / Vite / Tailwind CSS v4 with Cuba M3 executive glassmorphic styling, ensuring 100% functional parity with legacy implementations in `src/`:

1. **Core Candidate Shell & Navigation**:
   - CubaAppShell layout with active 'Resumes & Master CV', 'Cover Letters', 'Web CV Portfolio', 'Interview Coach', 'Job Tracker', 'Settings'.
   - 4-level breadcrumb path (`Dashboard > Resumes & Master CV > Build Resume > [Candidate Name / Title]`).
   - Reactive header with green 'Saved' pill, circular ATS score gauge, 'Preview' and 'Download v' buttons.

2. **Twelve-Step Resume Engine (TRUNCATION STRICTLY PROHIBITED)**:
   - **CRITICAL ANTI-TRUNCATION INVARIANT**: The developer MUST NOT reduce the step count to 6. All 12 legacy steps MUST be fully implemented:
     1. **Heading / Personal Info** (Photo uploader, 2-col icon grid, collapsible target role & JD)
     2. **Work History / Experience** (Company, role, dates, current toggle, AI bullet rewriter)
     3. **Education** (Institution, degree, field, dates, GPA, coursework)
     4. **Skills** (Deduplication against existing skills, category grouping, AI suggestions)
     5. **Summary** (Grounded AI Executive Bio synthesis from prior work history)
     6. **Certifications** (Deduplication, issuing body, credential ID, expiration)
     7. **Achievements** (Key quantifiable career accomplishments & awards)
     8. **Projects** (Project title, technologies, live URL, GitHub repo, descriptions)
     9. **Languages** (Language name and CEFR / proficiency level selector)
     10. **References** (Name, title, company, email, phone, reference relationship)
     11. **Custom Sections** (User-defined arbitrary section titles and items)
     12. **Review & Pre-Flight Checks** (ATS guidance checklist, missing field warnings)
   - **Right Rail Tabbed AI Career Assistant**: Suggestions tab, Resume Insights tab, Job Match tab, ATS Guidance checklist, and Bullet Strength bar.

3. **True A4 Multi-Page Pagination Engine (`ResumePageComposer.jsx`)**:
   - Preserve and modernize the 34 KB `ResumePageComposer.jsx` document engine.
   - Partition rendered templates into discrete 210 x 297 mm `.resume-page` sheets.
   - Two-column layouts: first-page sidebar strategy; continuation pages use full A4 width with continuation headers.
   - Section atomicity: blocks that exceed page boundaries move whole or split cleanly with `(continued)` labels.
   - Guarantee 1:1 on-screen to print pagination (`break-after: page`).

4. **Standalone AI Cover Letter Builder Suite (`/cover-letter` & `/coverletter`)**:
   - Preserve the full 114 KB `CoverLetter.jsx` standalone application.
   - Cover Letter templates (Cover1 through Cover4) with high-fidelity typography.
   - Tone selector (Professional, Modern, Creative, Executive), Job Description targeting, and AI paragraph generator.
   - Save, load, and export workflows.

5. **Interactive Web CV & Online Portfolio Builder Studio (`/portfolio/builder`)**:
   - Preserve the 105 KB `PortfolioBuilder.jsx` and 50 KB `WebCvStudio.jsx` studio.
   - Visual block editor: Hero, About, Projects, Experience, Skills, Testimonials, Contact.
   - Template presets, theme palette customizers, slug generator, and instant publish to `/portfolio/:slug`.

6. **Resume Import, Sync & ATS Scoring**:
   - Preserve `ResumeImportModal.jsx` (PDF and DOCX extraction, parsing error handling, user correction).
   - Preserve `SyncProfileModal.jsx` (LinkedIn profile synchronization and consent handling).
   - Preserve `AtsScoreMeter.jsx` with real scoring calculation, keyword breakdowns, and recommendations.

7. **All 51 CV Templates & Headless Export Route Guard Fix**:
   - All 51 templates must render in `cv-renderer.tsx` with high-fidelity typography.
   - **CRITICAL ROUTE GUARD FIX**: Headless Exporter routes (`/export/Cv1..51/:resumeId/:language` and `/export/Cover1..4/:resumeId/:language`) MUST use `RequireExportAccess`, allowing headless Chromium access via `#renderToken=...` without redirecting to `/login`.

8. **AI Interview Coach (Dual-Mode)**:
   - **Mode A (Text CBT Drills)**: Question/answer workflow, turn progression, real-time AI feedback.
   - **Mode B (Live Face-to-Face Studio)**: Preserve full functionality of `LiveInterviewSession.jsx` (1,695 lines: webcam video feed, AI talking avatar, real-time STT speech-to-text, live audio waveform, closed captions, floating resume drawer, session lifecycle).
   - *Headless Test Mandate*: Use Playwright arguments `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream` and `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream` for automated CI/test execution.

9. **Job Application Modal & Tracker**:
   - Preserve full functionality of the 111 KB `JobApplicationModal.jsx` (resume selection, live ATS matching, in-modal AI Quick Pitch generation, cover-letter generation, screening questions, validation, and submission).
   - Job Tracker pipeline (Applied, Interviewing, Offered, Rejected), Favourites, Notifications, Support, Settings, TOTP 2FA, and Account Deletion.

---

### 2. Invariants
- ZERO CAPABILITY LOSS: Full preservation of all 12 resume steps, CoverLetter (114 KB), PortfolioBuilder (105 KB), ResumePageComposer (34 KB), LiveInterviewSession (1,695 lines), and 51 CV templates.
- ZERO FABRICATED DATA: All scores, resumes, and stages must bind to real user data or render honest empty states.
- WCAG 2.1 AA ACCESSIBILITY & Sub-4s build.
invariants: ZERO CAPABILITY LOSS: Full preservation of all 12 resume builder steps (no 6-step truncation permitted).

CANDIDATE OVERVIEW STATS CONTRACT: Overview metrics MUST fetch from GET /api/user-stats with schema matching { resumes, coverLetters, portfolios, applications, trackedJobs, profileComplete }. Calling phantom /misc/user-stats is prohibited.
JOB TRACKER CONTRACT: Job tracker MUST call /api/jobs-data/tracker (never /jobs/tracker). Mutations (PATCH, DELETE) MUST pass integer expectedRevision for MariaDB optimistic locking.

ANTI-SIMULATION IN COVER LETTER: Cover letter AI generation MUST call POST /api/generate-ai-cover-letter and persist to GET/POST /api/covers/:id. Synthesizing fake letters in catch blocks (AGENTS.md Rule 7.2) is strictly prohibited.

PORTFOLIO BUILDER MARIADB PERSISTENCE: Modernized Portfolio Builder and WebCvStudio MUST wire to GET/POST /api/portfolios and POST /api/portfolios/:id/publish. Ephemeral-only local state is prohibited.
HEADLESS PDF EXPORT INTEGRITY: Export routes must use RequireExportAccess supporting #renderToken fragment authentication.
PARITY LOCK: Full preservation of CoverLetter (114 KB), PortfolioBuilder (105 KB), ResumePageComposer (34 KB), and LiveInterviewSession (1,695 lines).

USER PROFILE CONTRACT: Candidate profile MUST load from GET /api/users-data/profile and persist to POST /api/users-data/profile with payload schema { expectedRevision: number, profile: { ... } }. Calling unversioned phantom /users/profile or omitting expectedRevision is strictly prohibited.

SETTINGS & DANGER ZONE CONTRACT: Settings page (/dashboard/settings) MUST NOT contain dead buttons. Password update must invoke Firebase updatePassword, Danger Zone must implement GDPR personal data export (POST /api/account/export) and account deletion (POST /api/account/delete). TOTP 2FA unenrollment must bind to POST /api/users-data/mfa/disable.

CANDIDATE SUPPORT TICKET CONTRACT: Support desk MUST fetch from GET /api/support/tickets, view tickets at GET /api/support/tickets/:ticketId, create tickets via POST /api/support/tickets, and send replies via POST /api/support/tickets/:ticketId/messages (banning phantom /support/tickets/:id/reply).
ZERO FABRICATED PRODUCTION DATA: Zero mock scores or hardcoded candidate names in production views.
HEADLESS TEST COMPATIBILITY: Automated verification via synthetic media stream flags.
WCAG 2.1 AA ACCESSIBILITY: Full keyboard navigation and color contrast.
acceptanceCriteria: Candidate dashboard renders within CubaAppShell with 4-level breadcrumbs and reactive header controls.
Candidate dashboard overview cards bind to real GET /api/user-stats (resumes, coverLetters, portfolios, applications, trackedJobs, profileComplete).
Candidate profile loads from GET /api/users-data/profile and updates pass { expectedRevision, profile } to POST /api/users-data/profile without 404/400 errors.
Settings security tab verifies password updates, TOTP 2FA status/disable (/api/users-data/mfa/disable), GDPR export (/api/account/export), and account deletion (/api/account/delete).
Candidate support desk verifies ticket list, ticket creation, and ticket message posting (/api/support/tickets/:ticketId/messages).
Job Tracker loads from /api/jobs-data/tracker and stage/item mutations pass expectedRevision to MariaDB.
Twelve-step resume builder steps verified: Heading, Experience, Education, Skills, Summary, Certifications, Achievements, Projects, Languages, References, Custom Sections, Review.
ResumePageComposer verified: partitions multi-page resumes into discrete 210x297mm sheets with continuation headers.
Standalone Cover Letter Builder (/cover-letter) verified with Cover1-4 templates, POST /api/generate-ai-cover-letter, and GET/POST /api/covers/:id without fake catch-block synthesis.
Web CV Portfolio Builder (/portfolio/builder) verified with MariaDB persistence via /api/portfolios and publication to /portfolio/:slug.
All 51 CV templates and headless export routes (/export/Cv1..51/..., /export/Cover1..4/...) verified via RequireExportAccess.
Text CBT Drills and Live Face-to-Face Interview Studio verified with session creation and turn lifecycle.
JobApplicationModal verified with resume selector, ATS score match, and AI Quick Pitch.
Playwright tests pass with zero console errors using virtual media stream flags.
TypeScript check passes with zero errors (tsc -b).
